card.name: Archaic narrative verbs and nouns
card.fires_on: Mostly literary or older narrative prose, on a verb or noun in mid-story, such as the 'ang' of 'sprang' or 'came' in 'came up'. Also on nouns like breath, chamber and perceptions.

modes.label: Came up
modes.description: The verb 'came' before 'up' in a military advance narrative.
modes.example: As we<< came>> up we were deployed in like manner.

modes.label: Abstract nouns
modes.description: Nouns like perception or breath in older or philosophical text.
